Land Acquisition Notices

No. 1920/31 – FRIDAY, JUNE 26, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT (Chapter 460) Notice under Section 7

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by a the land Acquisition (amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/ servitude which is required for a public purpose:-

Description of the Land/servitude to be acquired: Allotment of land called Wathuyayawatta in Total Extent of 0.0662 Hectare, shown as Lot No. 1 in the Preliminary Plan No. M 1589 Prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village of Galaliyadda of Asgiri Pallesiyapattuwa Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Yatawatta in Matale District of Central Province.

01. Lot No. A - Wathuyayawatta - Extent: 0.0662 Hectare, Claimants: Wimalawathi de Silva and Anulawathi de Silva, Pubudugama, Elwala, Ukuwela. North: Road and Wathuyayawatta claiming by R. A. de Silva; East: Wathuyayawatta claiming by R. A. de Silva and Lot No. 2 of P.P.M. 1189; South: Lot No. 2 of this Plan, Lot No. 1 of P.P.M. 1189 and Wathuyayawatta claiming by R. A. de Silva; West: Wathuyayawatta claiming by R. A. de Silva. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in

writing, before me at Yatawatta Divisional Secretariat on the 26th day of August 2015 at 10.00 a. m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 12th day of August, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude* the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
A. M. J. K. N. ADIKARI, Divisional Secretary, Yatawatta.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Yatawatta. 03rd June, 2015. 07 - 550

AMENDMENT
LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (Chapter 460) Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: KDS/DEL/4/4/8/13-1. Land Ministry’s Reference No.: LD/05/2003/VE/16.

I, hereby give notice that the notice published by S. Balasubramaniyam (Divisional Secretary, Deltota) Under the above heading and Gazette No. 1492/26 and dated 12th April 2007, of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, is amended as follows.

I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following Land/Servitude* which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the Land or servitude to be acquired :-

An allotment of land called Littlevally watta in total extent of about 8.9740 Hectare depicted as Lot No. 1-6 in the Preliminary Plan No. Maha 5860 surveyed and prepared by the Surveyor-General situated in the Village of Udadeltota in Gamdahaya Korale Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Deltota in Kandy District in Central Province and bounded as follows:
Lot No. 1—Littlevally Watta—Extent 0.3364 Hectare
North: Littlevallywatta (H. P. 44605) and Estate Road; East: Estate Road; South: Deltota Oya; West: Deltota Oya and Little vally watta (H. P. 44605)
Lot No. 2 — Littlevally Watta — Extent 1.4839 Hectare

North: Estate Road, Littlevallywatta (H. P. 44605) and Deltota Oya; East: Estate Road; South: Estate Road; West: Estate Road, Littlevallywatta (H. P. 44605). Lot No. 3 — Littlevally Watta — Extent 0.3163 Hectare

North: Estate Road; East: Estate Road and Littlevallywatta (H. P. 44605); South: Littlevally watta (H. P. 44605) and stream; West: Stream and Lot No. 1 of PP Maha 2069. Lot No. 4 — Littlevally Watta — Extent 2.4294 Hectare

North: Lot No. 1 of PP Maha 2069 and Stream; East: Stream and Littlevally watta (H. P. 44605); South: Littlevally watta (H. P. 44605) and Foot path; West: Littlevally (H.P.44605) stream and Lot No. 1 of PP Maha 2069.
Lot No. 5 — Littlevally Watta — Extent 0.8420 Hectare

North: Stream, Estate Road and Littlevally watta (H. P. 44605); East: Littlevally watta (H. P. 44605) Foot path and stream; South: Stream and Road (R. D. A.); West: Road (R. D. A.) and Stream. Lot No. 6 — Littlevally Watta — Extent 3.5660 Hectare
North: Littlevally watta (H. P. 44605); East: Littlevallywatta (H. P. 44605); South: Littlevally watta (H. P. 44605) and Road (R. D. A.); West: Stream and Littlevally watta (H. P. 44605).

All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretary’s office at Deltota on the 12th day of August 2015, at 10.30 a. m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 17th day of July, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
J. P. U. K. JAYARATHNA, Divisional Secretary, Deltota.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Deltota 23rd June, 2015. 07 - 563
